name: Dragon Citadel: Endgame Rules
description: IMPORTANT: RUN INSTALL BILLADENC4 RUNTIME.CMD ONCE AFTER INSTALLING THE MOD. This module enforces one level 8 dragon per month, one-dragon neutral stacks, the 10% joining limit and Ruby Golem growth after every battle round.
author: Billaden

polish.name: Smocza Cytadela: Reguły Końca Gry
polish.description: WAŻNE: PO INSTALACJI MODA URUCHOM RAZ INSTALL BILLADENC4 RUNTIME.CMD. Moduł wymusza jednego smoka poziomu 8 raz na miesiąc, pojedyncze dzikie smoki, limit 10% szansy na dołączenie i rozwój Rubinowego Golema po każdej rundzie.
polish.author: Billaden

1.2.1: Fixed monthly town growth being checked against the old game date, which prevented all monthly recruits.
Preserved exactly one new recruit on month boundaries, including plague and neutral towns.
1.2.0: Rebased the matching BILLADENC4 runtime patch on VCMI 1.7.5.
Changed Ultimate and Absolute Dragon growth to exactly one dragon per month.
Kept Castle, Grail, plague and bonus-week effects from multiplying final dragon growth.
1.1.0: Added cumulative Ruby Golem growth after every completed battle round.
Added a prominent runtime installation warning.
1.0.0: Added initial custom growth handling for Ultimate and Absolute Dragons.
Kept wandering level 8 stacks and neutral sanctuary guards at one dragon.
Limited wandering level 8 joining eligibility to 10 percent.
